rules.conversion: last5 QB across-team attempts/dropbacks, 50 prior league dropbacks
rules.dropback_rate: last3 current-team sum dropbacks / sum plays, 100 league prior plays

rules.share: accepted expected QB only; last3 current-team QB dropbacks / team dropbacks, 20 prior dropbacks at share1 for an explicit single starter; no guessed assignment
